facts_of_case: The petitioner sought divorce under Section 13 of the Hindu Marriage Act on grounds of cruelty. The respondent denied allegations and the trial court dismissed the petition.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party alleging cruelty to prove it with cogent and reliable evidence.
legal_principles.held: From the perusal of the evidence, I am convinced that the petitioner has failed to substantiate allegations of cruelty against the respondent.

legal_principles.principle: The court will not interfere with the judgment of the Trial Court unless there is cogent and reliable evidence to warrant such interference.
legal_principles.held: There is no congent and reliable evidence which would warrant any interference in the judgment of the Trial Court.

outcome.final_order: The final order was dismissal of the appeal, upholding the trial court's decision to dismiss the divorce petition.
